item.name: Manage
item.effect: Opens remote management for income sources so you do not have to walk back to every building.
item.bestUse: Use it when the tycoon spreads across multiple sources and walking between buildings starts slowing upgrades.
item.resetNote: Check power availability after major resets before routing around it.
item.cardSummary: Manage is the remote-control power. It matters once your run has enough active sources that walking back to each one wastes time.

item.name: Run Faster
item.effect: Increases character movement speed across the map.
item.bestUse: Use it for travel between distant income sources, phone offers, map pickups, and newly unlocked zones.
item.resetNote: Check power availability after major resets before routing around it.
item.cardSummary: Run Faster is a travel power. It does not change income math directly, but it saves time whenever the run asks you to move.

item.name: Expert Picker
item.effect: Raises the value of fruit and money-bag pickups around the map.
item.bestUse: Use it when you are already collecting map pickups during travel or waiting for time-based income.
item.resetNote: Check power availability after major resets before routing around it.
item.cardSummary: Expert Picker makes scattered pickups more meaningful. It is best when map movement is already part of your run.

item.name: Stack Upgrades
item.effect: Lets upgrade effects stack together instead of only replacing the previous effect.
item.bestUse: Use it once repeat upgrades and global multipliers are doing more for the run than one-off purchases.
item.resetNote: Use it for upgrade effects during the current rebuild, then recheck after major resets.
item.cardSummary: Stack Upgrades is the compounding power. It matters when repeated upgrades and multiplier layers are driving the run.

item.name: Speed Up Time
item.bestUse: Use it when timers, managers, or delayed payouts are already producing enough value to be worth accelerating.
item.resetNote: Best checked after timers and managers are already worth accelerating.
item.cardSummary: Speed Up Time is the timer power. It is strongest when your active systems already have meaningful timed output.

item.name: Remote Buy
item.effect: Lets you purchase upgrades remotely without visiting each building.
item.bestUse: Treat it as deep endgame convenience after Evolution and investor scaling make map-wide rebuilding the main chore.
item.resetNote: Built for late rebuilds where walking to every purchase is the bottleneck.
item.cardSummary: Remote Buy is the endgame buying shortcut. It should not distract early or midgame players because it belongs to very deep progression.

item.name: Forever Purchase
item.effect: Makes one selected purchase permanent across major reset loops.
item.bestUse: Save it for a purchase that keeps helping every rebuild, such as a strong global multiplier target.
item.resetNote: Preserves one selected item across major reset loops; extra slots are tied to Ascension progress.
item.cardSummary: Forever Purchase is the reset-routing power. Its value comes from choosing one purchase that keeps paying off after the run resets.
